newsitem.title: ITALY: BENETTON COULD FLOAT SPORTSYSTEM BY END-97.
newsitem.headline: BENETTON COULD FLOAT SPORTSYSTEM BY END-97.

text.p: Italian clothing manufacturer and retailer Benetton Group SpA said it might float its entire Sportsystem division in New York by the end of 1997.
The Sportsystem group, comprising some 10 sports marques including Rollerblade skates and the Prince tennis brand, has turnover of over 1.4 trillion lire.

A Benetton spokeswoman said the idea was to quote the division in New York where the main marques were based. "It will certainly be New York. Analysis is going on but no date has been fixed yet, it could be by the end of 1997," she said.
Commenting on a press report about a possible listing in London next summer, the spokeswoman said it was premature to talk of a London float.
Benetton had originally planned a Wall Street listing of Rollerblade this summer. -- Milan newsroom +392 66129589
